rv.q: A storm is blowing into the town where the Albion pub sits, both meteorological and political. Inside the rundown establishment, Sanjana is a landlady who is on her last legs and ready to throw in the bar towel. Her husband has died and her loving teacher daughter only returns occasionally these days.

Her relationship with her daughter Anika ( Chaya Gupta ), though, is awkward, with underlying resentment. Each speech is delivered in song, with clever lighting effects that give the impression of a performance venue rather than a pub, making the intimate Tanya Moiseiwitsch Playhouse feel much bigger than it is.
